title: Ring Draft
description:
[h1]Your teammate drafts your deck.[/h1]

A co-op mod. Players sit in a ring, and the player before you makes your build decisions while you keep playing your own turns. They make them on the game's own screens, with your real cards, relics and shop.

[h2]The player before you picks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Your card rewards (pick 1 of 3, or skip)
[*]Your shop: they get your shop on the merchant rug and spend [b]your[/b] gold, including which card gets removed
[*]Which card you upgrade, after [b]you[/b] choose Smith over Rest
[*]Your Attack / Skill / Power potion choices and Toolbox-style relic choices, in combat too
[*]The cards from gifts you choose at Neow and the other Ancients: Scroll Boxes packs, Lost Coffer / Orrery / Glass Eye rewards, Hefty Tablet / Massive Scroll picks, and which cards Precise Scissors, Precarious Shears, New Leaf and Pomander remove, transform or upgrade
[/list]

[h2]You keep[/h2]
[list]
[*]Every combat turn, potion use and target
[*]Events, chests, elite relics, gold and potion rewards
[*]Which gift you take from an Ancient, Rest vs Smith, and your map path
[/list]

With 2 players it's a swap; with 3 or 4 it's a ring in seat order. When anyone opens a card reward or the shop, everyone's opens, so everybody picks for their neighbour at the same time. What your picker takes flies into your row in the player list. If your picker stalls, you get a "Choose myself" button. Nothing is ever chosen for you automatically.

[h2]Requirements[/h2]
[b]Everyone in the lobby needs this mod, on the same version.[/b] Built for v0.107.1. Unpolished beta: expect rough edges.

Settings: ringdraft_config.json in %APPDATA%\SlayTheSpire2 (created on first launch). Each player can turn off shop delegation, Ancient gifts, opening everyone's screens at once and more, and change the timeouts. Problems? Post ringdraft_log.txt from the same folder.
changeNote:
0.3.1
- Shop: when you shop for someone, their gold and potion belt now sit in your top bar right after yours, with their coin in their character's colour. Their gold counts down when you spend it, just like yours does.
- Potions you buy for them fly into their potion belt.
- Fixed: buying a potion when their belt was full (or they couldn't afford it) looked like it worked, but they never got it. The shop now refuses it the way the game does, and if their game says no, the item goes back on the shelf.
- When the shop closes, the second rug, their gold and their potions all slide away together.
- Everyone in the lobby needs 0.3.1.

0.3.1（简体中文）
- 商店：替别人购物时，对方的金币和药水栏会显示在你的顶部栏里，紧挨在你自己的后面，金币图标会染成对方角色的颜色。花对方的钱时，对方的金币数会像你自己的一样滚动减少。
- 替对方买的药水会飞进对方的药水栏。
- 修复：对方药水栏已满（或金币不够）时买药水，看起来像是买成了，对方却没有拿到。现在商店会像游戏原本那样拒绝购买；如果对方的游戏拒绝了这次购买，商品会回到货架上。
- 关闭商店时，第二张商人地毯、对方的金币和药水栏会一起收起。
- 房间里的所有人都需要更新到 0.3.1。
